title: Dorohedoro Season 2
synopsis:
The anarchy continues as Caiman inches closer to the truth behind his cursed appearance and the mystery around the Cross-Eyes' boss begins to unravel. 

 

(Source: Netflix Anime)

episodes.title: LET'S USE OUR RESOURCES WITH CARE / HORROR! BLOODY MANSION SLAUGHTER DANCE
episodes.synopsis:
Looks like Risu went out to the town of Berith to track down the Cross-Eyes’ hideout! Those Cross-Eyes guys live pretty modestly, you know.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: MEOTO ZENZAI / MASTEMA SUBNADE / THE TRAGIC TALE OF THE CROSS-EYES
episodes.synopsis:
Haru the Devil has shown up. What’s she doing chatting it up with Humans? Meanwhile, the lizard guy and Nikaido have arrived in Mastema.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: SWEET HOME / SHINING YOUTH / MEMORIES KEEP CIRCLING ROUND AND ROUND / COME BACK HOME
episodes.synopsis:
Seems En’s trying to make a buck from some no-good mushrooms again, and it looks like the lizard guy remembered something important.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: GOLDEN BEETLES ARE RICH / CUTE BUTCHER / DOOR TO THE PAST
episodes.synopsis:
So the Cross-Eyes gang figured they’d make the landlord’s murder look like a suicide, huh? As for Asu, who dared to keep things from me, I made sure he paid for it.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: MEETING IN THE RAIN / TRAVEL COMPANIONS / FINAL NIGHT FOR TWO
episodes.synopsis:
Looks like Ebisu got her memory back, thanks to eating some weird mushrooms, and now she’s all eager to head back to her parents’ place.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: FAREWELL, CAIMAN/ MEMORY BUBBLES
episodes.synopsis:
En’s found the lizard guy and Nikaido, and they’re going at it hard. Meanwhile, the Cross-Eyes guys are sitting around swapping stories about their boss.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: MY SECRET PLAN/CROSS-EYE EXPEDITION/DEFORMED REUNION
episodes.synopsis:
Fujita's losing his mind trying to get Kikurage to bring Ebisu back to life. The Cross-Eyes guys are scrambling for cash, and things around En are starting to get kind of dicey.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: CHAOS SHOCK/ BLACK BOX/ ROOM 501
episodes.synopsis:
I never imagined En would go down that easily. The sorcerers are thrown into total chaos. And now I get why Nikaido doesn't use magic.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: MOSH PIT/ CROSS-EYES IN THE NEWS
episodes.synopsis:
The Cross-Eyes boss has finally shown up. The En Family's been wiped out, and it looks like the Cross-Eyes have taken over that huge mansion.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: LUCKY JERK/ ADVANCED MAGIC
episodes.synopsis:
Looks like they've found missing Kikurage. And that bastard Asu, well, Kawajiri now, is sneaking around, up to something weird again. That Haru chick’s getting a little too carried away.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: BALLAD OF THE HAPPY DESTRUCTION/ QUESTION & ANSWER
episodes.synopsis:
Looks like Kawajiri and Nikaido have slipped into En's mansion, which the Cross-Eyes have taken over. There, Nikaido runs right into Aikawa. The mystery surrounding the Cross-Eyes boss just keeps getting deeper.

(Source: Crunchyroll)
